items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: He used to play with Peter in there.

ctx.x: He was a great piano player, but he'd bust up there, he got to fooling with that stuff

there and he'd wound up, he'd wound up in the crazy house. He used to play with Peter in there. What was he doing? Was he shooting up or was he snitching? What was he doing? Was he shooting up or was he snitching? What was he doing? He was shooting up.
